# Metkagram — full AI discovery guide

> Multilingual language-learning and NLP knowledge site with canonical patterns, annotated examples, reasoning packs, practice sets, and provenance-aware retrieval.

## Start here

- Website: https://metkagram.github.io/
- English learning hub: https://metkagram.github.io/en/
- Pattern Atlas: https://metkagram.github.io/en/explore/english/
- Practice sets: https://metkagram.github.io/en/practice/sets/
- AI and integrations: https://metkagram.github.io/en/ai/
- Research: https://metkagram.github.io/en/research/

## Machine-readable sources

- Agent profile: https://metkagram.github.io/ai/site-profile.json
- API index: https://metkagram.github.io/api/v1/index.json
- OpenAPI: https://metkagram.github.io/api/v1/openapi.json
- Search index: https://metkagram.github.io/api/v1/search-index.json
- Data catalogue: https://metkagram.github.io/data/catalog.json
- Attribution and provenance: https://metkagram.github.io/api/v1/attribution.json
- MCP-compatible tool description: https://metkagram.github.io/api/v1/mcp-server.json

## Retrieval rules

1. Resolve canonical pattern or study-set URLs before citing a record.
2. Preserve language, source, provenance, and dataset version.
3. Prefer reviewed and canonical records over migration or legacy aliases.
4. Treat generated practice material as learning support, not linguistic authority.
5. Keep translations and cross-language transfers explicit; do not infer equivalence without the published relation.

## Public scope

Metkagram is an educational language-learning and NLP knowledge project. Check the published license and attribution metadata before reuse.
